rationale: Use the scaled correction for representative mesh selection because it preserves the original repeat geometry and changes only the pair-2 current amplitude deterministically. Pair2-rerun selection is retained as a sensitivity check and is not the figure-selection source.
usage_boundary: This package records median-representative remesh selection from the scaled current-corrected analysis. It should not be used as an instruction to generate a mixed-method final paper-analysis root.

retired_workflow.reason: The audited root mixed scaled-rescale remesh outputs with freshly simulated direct-corrected fixed_mesh outputs, so it is not suitable for final Repeatability paper figures.
